plan: An insect assassin who hunts isolated targets and turns invisible to finish them off.
aSurveiller: His Q (Taste Their Fear). It deals much more damage when you are alone: stay near an ally or a minion.
contrer: Never end up alone: his spells hurt much more on an isolated target.
Play near your allies in the jungle: he hunts isolated players.
Once his leap (E) is used, he struggles to escape: punish him.
forces: His spells evolve over the game.
faiblesses: Relies on his leap to engage and escape.

sorts.P: Spots isolated targets; empowered attack if unseen.
sorts.Q: Strike that hurts much more on an isolated target.
sorts.W: Fires spikes that damage and heal him.
sorts.E: Leaps to an area and damages around him.
sorts.R: Turns invisible and evolves one of his spells.

momentFort: Dangerous from level 6, and very strong in the mid game.
